meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 创作 HyperFrames 幻灯片:分页展示、片段逐条显现、热点跳转分支、带演讲者备注的演示者模式;也可把现有网页转成这种可翻页 deck。产出是可浏览的 deck,不是视频。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做“slideshow”等幻灯片时直接制作;若只是提到 presentation、deck 等词,或要求把现有网页转成演示,会先询问确认再动手。

say.text: 把这页网页转成幻灯片,保留原来的动画和交互
say.note: 确认后会把网页转成可翻页的 deck。

say.text: 做一份 pitch deck,给每页加上演讲者备注
say.note: 生成 deck,备注只在演示者模式显示。

say.text: 在第3页加一个热点,点击跳到补充数据的分支页
say.note: 添加热点,观众点击后跳到分支页。

howto.what_en: Creates a HyperFrames slideshow: a navigable deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, and presenter mode with speaker notes; can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow; for adjacent requests like “presentation” or “deck”, or converting an existing page, it confirms with the user before building.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a slideshow, keeping its animations and interactions.
say_en.note: It will confirm, then turn the page into a navigable deck.

say_en.text: Make a pitch deck with speaker notes on every slide.
say_en.note: It generates the deck; notes show only in presenter mode.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that jumps to a branch page with extra data.
say_en.note: Adds a clickable region linked to a branch sequence.
